description: Phase 4 + 5 landing pages (plan item 9, D6): 7 new service pages, new /industries/[slug] route with 3 industry pages, 4 unique location pages (Zirakpur, Kharar, Ambala, Shimla), cannibalisation clarification on /services/regulated-software and /gxp-software-development-india, hub/footer/sitemap/llms.txt wiring. Depends on FEAT-001 (titles, revalidate, published-link filtering) and FEAT-002 (footer regulated column, ProofSlot/PricingBlock in LandingView).
steps: Add kind 'industry' to src/content/landing/types.ts; landingJsonLd (src/components/pages/landing-seo.ts) emits Service schema for industry pages; create src/content/landing/industries.ts (INDUSTRY_PAGES, parent Industries) and export it from src/content/landing/index.ts + ALL_LANDING_PAGES; create src/app/industries/[slug]/page.tsx modelled on src/app/services/[slug]/page.tsx (dynamicParams=false, revalidate=3600).

Append to SERVICE_PAGES in src/content/landing/services.ts: /services/lims-software-development, /services/pharmacovigilance-software, /services/computer-system-validation, /services/saas-development-company-india, /services/ai-chatbot-development-india, /services/hire-dedicated-developers-india, /services/ecommerce-development-chandigarh (city Chandigarh) — angles exactly as in plan item 9; each with answer in the first 2 lines (style: 'Bright Infonet is a Panchkula-based software company that builds ...'), metaTitle <= 60, description 140-160, about paragraphs, 2 card sections, fit list, 6 FAQs, >= 3 related links, serviceType, no prices/clients/numbers.

Write the 3 industry pages in industries.ts: /industries/pharma-software (hub linking LIMS, PV, CSV, regulated-software, GxP India), /industries/diagnostic-lab-software (NABL/ISO 15189, patient reports, LIS-style workflows), /industries/healthcare-app-development (clinic booking, patient apps, telehealth, DPDP Act).

Append 4 LOCAL_PAGES in src/content/landing/local.ts: /app-development-company-zirakpur, /software-development-company-kharar, /software-development-company-ambala, /web-development-company-shimla; each written from scratch with real geography, nearby areas, generally known local industry context (no statistics, no local client claims), city-specific FAQs, delivery model (remote + Panchkula base); compare against existing local pages so no paragraph is reused.

Cannibalisation: on /services/regulated-software (services.ts) and /gxp-software-development-india (local.ts) make the answer clearly the umbrella / India-wide angle and add a paragraph + related links to the 3 specialist pages.

Hubs: /services page (src/app/services/page.tsx) gets a 'Specialist services' link list; /industries page links each industry card to its new page (INDUSTRY_DETAILS related in src/components/pages/content.ts or a new list); Footer.tsx: Regulated software column gets LIMS, PV, CSV, pharma + diagnostic-lab links, Services column the 4 other new services, Areas the 4 new cities; sitemap.ts adds INDUSTRY_PAGES; llms.txt adds an Industries section.
Build, serve, crawl; record per-page word counts and any warnings in findings.
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint and npm run build pass
All 14 new URLs return 200 on next start -p 3100, appear in /sitemap.xml and /llms.txt, and are linked from at least one hub plus the footer (crawler reports no orphans)
Crawler 0 errors; no title/description length warnings, no thin-content warnings, FAQ schema matches visible text, each new page has Service + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD
No existing URL changed; no invented prices, clients, numbers or claims on new pages
The 4 location pages share no repeated paragraphs with each other or existing local pages (manual diff noted in findings)
verification: npx next start -p 3100 (background) then node .kiro/skills/seo-audit/scripts/audit.mjs http://localhost:3100 --out .agents/seo-audit-2026-10-04.md
curl.exe -s http://localhost:3100/sitemap.xml and http://localhost:3100/llms.txt — confirm the 14 new paths

findings.summary: All 7 steps done and verified on a normal production build served with next start -p 3100. 14 new URLs live, wired into hubs, footer, sitemap and llms.txt. Server stopped, temp check scripts deleted, no commits.

files.new: src/content/landing/industries.ts (INDUSTRY_PAGES: pharma-software, diagnostic-lab-software, healthcare-app-development), src/app/industries/[slug]/page.tsx (generateStaticParams, dynamicParams=false, revalidate=3600; same shape as services/[slug])

evidence.served_checks: All 14 new URLs 200; each in /sitemap.xml and /llms.txt; each linked from the home footer; one <h1>; canonical = own URL; JSON-LD has Service + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage. Hubs: 7 new services linked from the /services 'Specialist services' list (in <main>), 3 industry pages + SaaS + e-commerce from /industries cards; location pages from footer 'Areas we serve'. In-content inbound links from other landing pages (inside <main>): LIMS 6, PV 4, CSV 6, SaaS 3, chatbot 4, dedicated 3, e-commerce 6, pharma 5, diagnostic 4, healthcare 3, Zirakpur 3, Kharar 2, Ambala 2, Shimla 2. Outgoing internal links in <main>: 8-9 per page. llms.txt has '## Industries' with the /industries line + 3 industry pages.
evidence.titles_descriptions: Rendered <title> lengths 44-55 (Kharar/Ambala get the ' | Bright Infonet' suffix via seoTitle); descriptions 153-160 chars; answers 52-57 words (regulated-software 54, gxp India 57 after rewording).
evidence.crawler: Normal build: 70 pages (56 + 14) | Errors 0 | Warnings 7 | Info 0. The 7 WARNs are the same pre-existing article-body-link warnings from FEAT-001 (work list for FEAT-006). 0 title/description length, 0 thin-content, 0 orphan, 0 'FAQ schema question not visible' warnings. Report: .agents/seo-audit-2026-10-04.md.
evidence.uniqueness_diff: Scripted diff over all landing data (services, local, industries, academy: lead, answer, about, fit, card texts, FAQ answers): 0 exact duplicate strings involving any new page. 8-word shingle check: the 4 location pages share NO 8-word sequence with each other or with any existing landing page (two stock cost-FAQ phrasings on Shimla/Ambala reworded to get there). Remaining overlaps on the service/industry pages are short brand or stock phrases only ('Bright Infonet is a Panchkula-based software company that…', 'written, itemised estimate after…', '21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11'); a near-copy audit-trail card and Part 11 FAQ on the LIMS page were rewritten.
evidence.claims_check: No prices, client names, logos, stats or timelines invented. Only existing proof referenced: PVgenix and the LIMS 'as described on our work page' (wording matches /work). Clinic booking showcase (marked PLACEHOLDER in data.ts) is NOT cited. Cost FAQs answer 'itemised written estimate' only. Regulatory statements are hedged: Part 11/NABL compliance depends on the client's procedures and QA; DPDP Act interpretation stays with the client's legal advisers; MedDRA licence stays with the client; analyser/ERP/accounting integrations 'confirmed during discovery'. Local context stated generally (Peer Muchalla borders Panchkula; Kharar on the Mohali–Ropar road near campuses; Ambala's scientific-instrument trade; Shimla tourism via the Kalka highway); no distances or statistics.
evidence.urls_unchanged: No existing path renamed or removed; only additions to arrays and text edits on two existing pages (/services/regulated-software, /gxp-software-development-india).

for_later_feats: New industry pages: add entries to INDUSTRY_PAGES (src/content/landing/industries.ts); route, sitemap and llms.txt pick them up automatically. Link them from INDUSTRY_DETAILS[].page if they map to an /industries card.

The /services 'Specialist services' list is automatic: any SERVICE_PAGES entry whose slug is not one of the five SERVICE_DETAILS slugs appears there. The footer lists are hand-maintained (REGULATED, MORE_SERVICES, AREAS in Footer.tsx).

Natural CTA/cluster targets for FEAT-004 posts: /services/computer-system-validation (validation guide hub, URS template, Annex 11, CSV vs CSA), /services/lims-software-development (LIMS checklist, URS, NABL ISO 15189 -> also /industries/diagnostic-lab-software), /services/pharmacovigilance-software (E2B(R3) explainer). Comparison pages (FEAT-005?) can link /services/saas-development-company-india and /services/hire-dedicated-developers-india.

Owner: siteConfig.areaServed now matters for Ambala and Shimla pages (FEAT-002 added them with a CONFIRM comment); the pages say 'no office in Kharar/Ambala/Zirakpur' and describe remote + visit delivery — confirm that is accurate.
gotchas: Node 24 imports the landing .ts files directly (type-only imports are stripped), handy for length/duplicate checks without tsx; index.ts cannot be imported that way (extensionless runtime imports).
$home is a read-only automatic variable in PowerShell; and curl.exe output is a line array, so -match on it returns arrays. Easier to verify served HTML with a small node fetch script.
Sitemap <loc> values are absolute production URLs (https://www.brightinfonet.com/...); use new URL(loc).pathname when re-fetching them from localhost.
